score_evidence.E: Tables where comparison helps (hook events L139, middleware stages L265, intervention methods L743, migration L633, stop reasons L922), ASCII diagrams labelled as illustrations, runnable code per mechanism. Deductions: max(1.2, 0.8) display math L63-68 is trivial for the reader; the stash table L617-621 repeats the paragraph above it.
score_evidence.F: One wrong claim in the sample: deployment via 'pip install bedrock-agentcore-starter-toolkit' + 'agentcore configure' (L1110-1116) while the current Strands deploy page says 'The AgentCore CLI replaces the previously available bedrock-agentcore-starter-toolkit ... uninstall it' (npm @aws/agentcore, agentcore create/dev/deploy/invoke). Outside the sample: Python steering is a plugin ('Attach the handler with plugins=[handler]'; 'in Python, steering handlers are plugins'), but L862 and L887 put LLMSteeringHandler in the interventions list of the Python order agent. Omission: context_manager is marked 'Experimental Feature' on its docs page; the post (L558-640) presents it without that caveat. Each wrong case -2.

Python steering is a plugin (plugins=[handler]), but L862/L887 register LLMSteeringHandler in the Python agent's interventions list.

Shared-agent checklist items repeat: THROW not scoped to invoke_async, no sync-blocking note, no history carry-over warning or invoke_async advice (L965-975); plus no SDK install/extras step and context_manager shown without its Experimental label.
